fields.label: Default Pickup Address & Contact
fields.description: Applied to new Shipments when these fields are empty. Leave blank to skip.

fields.label: Default Pickup Contact Person
fields.description: Company pickup contact is a User (ERPNext resolves the contact from the user).

fields.label: Auto-fill Description of Content from item names
fields.description: When the Description of Content is empty, fill it from the linked Delivery Note item names.

fields.label: Auto-populate parcels from Delivery Notes
fields.description: On save, when the Shipment has no parcels yet, build them from the linked Delivery Notes (item parcel templates). Never overwrites parcels you entered.

fields.label: Delay Threshold (days)
fields.description: A shipment counts as delayed after this many days from Pickup Date without delivery. Used by the daily check, the flag and the report/card.

fields.label: Auto-email Max Age (days)
fields.description: Only auto-email shipments delayed at most this many days, so old / abandoned untracked shipments are skipped (they still appear in the report and flag). 0 = no upper limit. Does not affect the manual 'Ask Carrier about Delay' button.

fields.label: Delay Email Sender (Account)
fields.description: Outgoing Email Account used as the sender (From) for delay emails — both the automatic ones and the 'Ask Carrier about Delay' button. Leave blank to use the default outgoing account.

fields.label: Delay Email Signature
fields.description: Appended to the automatic delay emails (internal + carrier). Plain text or simple HTML; line breaks are kept. Leave blank for no signature.

fields.label: Auto-email me per delayed shipment
fields.description: When the daily check first finds a shipment delayed, email its details to the recipient(s) below. The email is linked to the shipment and shows in its Activity. Sent once per shipment.

fields.label: Internal Recipient(s)
fields.description: Comma-separated email address(es) that receive the per-shipment delay notification. Leave blank to disable.

fields.label: Auto-email the carrier per delayed shipment
fields.description: ⚠ Sends a real email to the carrier (DPD/FedEx address below) automatically when a shipment first becomes delayed. Linked to the shipment and shown in its Activity. Sent once per shipment. Keep OFF until tested.

fields.label: DPD Delay Inquiry Email
fields.description: Carrier email used as recipient for DPD shipments — both the 'Ask Carrier about Delay' button and (if enabled) the automatic carrier email.

fields.label: FedEx Delay Inquiry Email
fields.description: Carrier email used as recipient for FedEx shipments — both the 'Ask Carrier about Delay' button and (if enabled) the automatic carrier email.

fields.label: Customer Shipping Charge Account
fields.description: Optional. If you charge customers for shipping via a Sales Taxes & Charges row on this account, the Delivery Note's Customer Shipping Charge is auto-filled from it (for the shipping margin). Leave blank if shipping is free.

fields.label: Sender Name on Claim Form
fields.description: Printed as 'Versendername / Sender' on the DPD declaration form (your brand as it appears on the DPD parcel label). Falls back to the shipment's pickup company when blank.

fields.label: Presumed Lost After (days)
fields.description: A shipment undelivered this many days after Pickup Date is flagged Presumed Lost (carriers rarely mark parcels Lost). Surfaced in the Presumed Lost report/card for a claim decision.

fields.label: DPD NL Claim Email (Germany)
fields.description: Recipient for 'Submit to Carrier' on German shipments (DPD Netherlands, Oirschot form).

fields.label: DPD BELUX Claim Email
fields.description: Recipient for 'Submit to Carrier' on Belgium/NL/LU shipments.

fields.label: Claim Email CC
fields.description: Optional CC on claim submissions (e.g. SendCloud / your own address).

fields.label: DPD Claim Window (days)
fields.description: Days from dispatch to file a loss claim with DPD. Used to compute the claim deadline.

fields.label: Deadline Reminder (days before)
fields.description: Email the Internal Recipient(s) this many days before a claim's deadline if it hasn't been submitted to the carrier yet. Sent once per claim. 0 = off.

fields.label: Enable SLA notifications
fields.description: Daily check: email the Internal Recipient(s) (see Delayed Shipment Alerts) when an undelivered shipment is at risk of missing, or has missed, its SLA date. The SLA Date and Status are computed regardless of this switch.

fields.label: At-Risk Warning (days before)
fields.description: Flag/notify 'At Risk' this many days before the SLA date while still undelivered.

fields.label: DPD SLA (transit days)
fields.description: Delivery-time SLA in days from Pickup Date for DPD (used when no Promised Delivery Date is set).

fields.label: Default SLA (transit days)
fields.description: Fallback transit-day SLA for carriers without a specific value above.
